title: Brad M Probable NDE 6101
content: I was taken to hospital, I had a bad cold. The nurse wouldn't give me a blanket and I was shivering. It was winter, and they said I had to stay overnight. They didn't understand my high temperature, then low temperature situation. The nurse thought a blanket would make it worse - that it was some sort of virus and fresh air would help me. They placed me in a large dim room, placed me in a bed near a window and she opened the window. After Mom and Dad went home, it got cold, really cold. No one could hear me. I saw the snowflakes falling on the sill, blowing occasionally onto my face. Soon my voice wouldn't work anymore, but the bitter cold numbed me. The only things there were the dark room, the snowflakes, and me. Suddenly a large angel appeared. He spoke to my mind, and I could understand, just like an adult. He asked me if I wanted to leave or stay. I felt very powerful in his presence, like nothing was going to harm me, and anything I said was alright. I no longer feared or felt death. His words were understood fully and completely without any words. I saw myself before I was sent here. I remembered a previous conversation while picking out my parents. I told the angel, 'Wealthy or poor, I don't want to bail out; I will stay.' He said, 'The dark forces are around you, this is a big challenge.' I said, 'I can do it.' Suddenly I woke to a sheet over my head, as the next day was here. I heard my mother say that they thought I'd passed away. He moved me and found me alive, the doctor was saying. 'It's your son, you can take him home to die, or leave him here, whatever is more comfortable for you.' Mom said, 'Take him home to be around his own family, he's just a baby.' At home, I drank soup, spent months lying around. I pulled through. I saw angels in my yard that no one else could see. As I got older, I saw my sister, who died two months before my death experience. My parents did not tell me about the car wreck. Through my life, I still see things others do not, feel things. I see signs in the atmosphere and in animals that let me know God is with me. I have had many strange events, too many to write. The hospital burned to the ground three days later after I was released from the hospital. The miracle was that only one person died in the fire. Ironically, that one person was my nurse!

arrival.other_being_detail: A "large angel" appeared and communicated mind-to-mind.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Angel asked if he wanted to "leave or stay"; he chose to stay, describing it as a "big challenge" with "dark forces" around him.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied task/challenge: to stay despite "dark forces" and a "big challenge."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Premortal memory of choosing parents; angel presence; question to leave or stay; return/waking with sheet over head.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/life review described; experience centers on angelic encounter, premortal memory, and a choice to stay, followed by waking in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Premortal memory of "picking out my parents" and recalling a prior conversation; later claims of seeing angels and perceiving signs in atmosphere/animals; hospital burned down three days after release and the nurse died in the fire.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "He spoke to my mind, and I could understand, just like an adult." "He asked me if I wanted to leave or stay." "Wealthy or poor, I don't want to bail out; I will stay." "The dark forces are around you, this is a big challenge."
